loss_ledger.purpose: The losses the Phase 7 matrix must publish beside its rows. Every measured number names an in-clone source and one command that recomputes it; a void number names the evidence-map claim whose status says why it is void. release-matrix refuses the whole matrix (MATRIX_LEDGER_INVALID) if a source is missing or a quoted value no longer recomputes, so a loss cannot outlive its artifact.

note: One row per registered lineage, one status per row from a closed vocabulary. A row at another serve config is certified_at_other_config, not a pass; a row with no packet is UNMEASURED and still prints the command that would fill it; a narrowed suite, a lowered cap, a scale past the grid or a head-to-head at two configs is invalid and exits non-zero. Every number is copied from the packet named on the row (or recomputed from the saved wave for a reference with no packet); nothing here measures a model.
